name: circulo-and-varas
description: Two small, dependency-free pieces of an agent's self-model. `varas` answers «what is normal for me?»; `circulo` answers «what have I actually learned?». Either works alone; together an agent can hold both at once.

plugins.name: circulo
plugins.description: Skill trees an agent has to earn and can lose: mastery read from accumulated evidence rather than granted, with decay of unused fluency and a visible record of who judged.

plugins.name: varas
plugins.description: Give your agent its own normals: thresholds calibrated against its own measured history instead of hand-picked constants. Detects when a channel's regime has changed.
